calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date) AS max_dim FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY period_start_date

SELECT f.sale_date, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, min(f.quantity) AS minq
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.sku=101624 AND s.store_id=131 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT 'stg' AS src, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d, sum(quantity) AS units FROM stg_sales_line_load s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=s.store_key WHERE p.sku=101624 AND st.store_id=131 AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret', count(*), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id), sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.sku=101624 AND st.store_id=131 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

calls.statement: SELECT s.sales_line_id, s.sale_date, s.quantity, s.net_amount, s.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id AS in_fact, f.quantity AS fact_qty, f.sale_date AS fact_date FROM stg_sales_line_load s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=s.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=s.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id WHERE p.sku=101624 AND st.store_id=131 AND s.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'

SELECT f.sale_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY f.store_key, f.sale_date

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, st.store_id, st.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name,
  sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product rp ON rp.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE rp.sku=101624 AND rs.store_id=131 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS returned_in_week
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE p.sku=101624 AND st.store_id=131 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week=22
GROUP BY ALL
